glance.summary: OpenAI will test sharing up to 1,000 megawatts of data center power during local emergencies.
The New York Times is suing web browser Brave for allegedly scraping and distributing copyrighted news content.
Anthropic updated Claude Code to block developers from using the AI tool to copy existing video games.
Salesforce agreed to acquire Cresta to bring advanced AI voice agents into its customer management software.

big_pour.headline: OpenAI plans data center power relief during emergencies
big_pour.summary: OpenAI announced it will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming Georgia data center, pledging up to 1,000 megawatts of power during emergencies or extreme weather.
big_pour.why: Nearby residents could receive extra electricity during extreme weather to keep air conditioners running.

explain.kid: OpenAI is making an upcoming computer data center in Georgia that can free up power for nearby homes during bad weather.
explain.pm: OpenAI will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" in Georgia, freeing up 1,000 megawatts of data center power during extreme weather or emergencies.
explain.engineer: OpenAI's upcoming Effingham County data center will pilot freeing up 1,000 megawatts of power during emergencies, releasing capacity to local electrical grids.

big_pour.headline: Anthropic blocks Claude from cloning existing video games
big_pour.summary: Anthropic updated Claude Code's system prompt to stop the tool from recreating existing video games, though users may still use it to make original games.

big_pour.headline: New York Times sues Brave over content scraping
big_pour.summary: The New York Times is suing browser company Brave for allegedly scraping copyrighted material and distributing it to customers like Anthropic and Perplexity.

office_blend.headline: Circle K speeds up DevOps incident triage
office_blend.summary: Circle K built an automated triage system on Amazon Bedrock, cutting incident response times from up to an hour to under 15 minutes.

office_blend.headline: Worldwide Express automates freight billing exceptions
office_blend.summary: Worldwide Express built a multi-agent solution on Amazon Bedrock, cutting active billing exceptions by 75% and unlocking $10 million in free cash flow.

still_roasting.summary: Apple will release Apple Intelligence in China with an iOS 27.3 beta in November, followed by a full December rollout.
DeepMind unveiled its Genie 4 world model, which will roll out soon to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.

quick_sips.summary: Grok Bot usage limits were cut back by Elon Musk due to unsustainably high costs.
OpenAI is combining ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs to share usage allowances with Codex.
Salesforce agreed to acquire Cresta to bring advanced voice agents into its customer management software.

stories.label: New tool
stories.headline: Canva Brush edits images by writing code
stories.summary: Canva launched Canva Brush, a vision-language model for designers that writes code to edit images rather than generating graphics directly.

stories.label: Policy update
stories.headline: Anthropic lifts five-hour cap on Claude Code
stories.summary: Anthropic removed the rolling five-hour usage cap on Claude Code for users subscribed to its $200 plan.

long_read.headline: Anthropic kills the coding interview
long_read.summary: The newsletter reports that Anthropic deleted coding interviews from its hiring process, arguing that AI has made traditional programming tests obsolete.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: A design where a person reviews or approves certain AI actions before they take effect.
word.analogy: Like the manager signing off before a new drink goes on the board.
